title: Activate Runner v3.6 after safe finalize
description: Use v3.5 only to arm a delayed switch helper. The helper waits until v3.5 has saved task 020a2 as its last executed ID, then starts v3.6 with the required TaskUrl, verifies v3.6 is running, and only then stops the captured v3.5 process. If v3.6 fails to start, v3.5 remains running.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $src='C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1'; $dst='C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path $src)){throw 'v3.5 missing'}; if(-not(Test-Path $dst)){throw 'v3.6 missing'}; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $b=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\020a2' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $b|Out-Null; Copy-Item $src (Join-Path $b '3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1') -Force; Copy-Item $dst (Join-Path $b '3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1') -Force; if(Test-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.state.json'){Copy-Item 'C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.state.json' (Join-Path $b '3en-agent.state.json') -Force}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$b); Write-Host 'BACKUP_020A2_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $helper='C:\3EN-Agent\switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1'; $old=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1*' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId); if(@($old).Count -eq 0){throw 'Active v3.5 process not found'}; $oldCsv=($old -join ','); $lines=[string[]]@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Continue''',('$oldPids=@('+$oldCsv+')'),'$stateFile=''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.state.json''','$v36=''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1''','$taskUrl=''https://api.github.com/repos/3en4all/3en-command-runner/contents/task.json?ref=main''','$deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(60)','$saved=$false','while((Get-Date)-lt $deadline){ try{ if(Test-Path $stateFile){ $s=Get-Content $stateFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if($s.lastExecutedId -eq ''2026-09-09-020a2''){ $saved=$true; break } } }catch{}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }','if(-not $saved){ Add-Content ''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.log'' ''SWITCH_020A2=ABORT state-not-finalized''; exit 20 }','$p=Start-Process -FilePath ''powershell.exe'' -ArgumentList @(''-NoProfile'',''-ExecutionPolicy'',''Bypass'',''-File'',$v36,''-TaskUrl'',$taskUrl) -PassThru','Start-Sleep -Seconds 6','$new=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like ''*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId)','if(@($new).Count -gt 0){ foreach($pidOld in $oldPids){ Stop-Process -Id $pidOld -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Add-Content ''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.log'' (''SWITCH_020A2=PASS V36_PIDS=''+($new -join '','')) } else { Add-Content ''C:\3EN-Agent\3en-agent.log'' ''SWITCH_020A2=FAIL V35_LEFT_RUNNING''; exit 21 }'); Set-Content -LiteralPath $helper -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8; $tok=$null;$err=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; if(@($err).Count -gt 0){throw ('Helper syntax errors='+@($err).Count)}; Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$helper) | Out-Null; Write-Host ('OLD_V35_PIDS='+$oldCsv); Write-Host ('HELPER='+$helper); Write-Host 'SWITCH_HELPER_020A2_ARMED=TRUE'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $helper='C:\3EN-Agent\switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path $helper)){throw 'helper missing'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; if(@($err).Count -gt 0){throw ('helper syntax errors='+@($err).Count)}; Write-Host 'HELPER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT=0'; Write-Host '020A2_READY_FOR_FINALIZE=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'No automatic rollback in this task. Helper leaves v3.5 running unless v3.6 starts successfully. Verified backups are stored under C:\3EN-Agent\backups\020a2.'
